codex_consult.feedback_summary: 7 questions challenged. Q1 (concurrent mapping upserts): NOT-ADDRESSED initially — codex identified real lost-update race because fire-and-forget upserts share the same .tmp.<pid> file and read-merge-write can interleave. Recommended a serialization queue per file. Q2 (atomic-write fault model coverage): NOT-ADDRESSED initially — test did not cover fault B (kill-after-rename, before parent-fsync). Q3 (M8 v1 fallback claude UUID preservation): ADDRESSED with a clarifying nit (flavor-gated, not strictly schemaVersion-gated). Q4 (Zod schema additivity vs hidden consumers): ADDRESSED — hidden consumers use fetch+json, not strict Zod, so optional fields don't break them. Q5 (import cycle): ADDRESSED — no new cycles. Q6 (RESULT tid coverage): ADDRESSED — test uses mockResolvedValue({threadId: resultTid}) different from requestedTid. Q7 (over-engineering): MINOR-NIT — glue module size defensible after Q1 serialization fix. ADDITIONAL BUG: stopSession() and heartbeat pruning didn't call codexMapping.onSessionEnd() before deleting tracked sessions — stale mapping rows could survive PID reuse.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Q1 FIXED: added internal promise-chain serialization queue inside codexMappingDaemon (state.chain promise chain; all mutations enqueued). Added 7 new tests in codexMappingDaemon.test.ts proving serialized upsert+upsert ordering, upsert+remove ordering, 10 interleaved operations across different sessions, sweep dead-pid removal, getPendingCodexSessionIds accuracy. Q2 FIXED: added explicit AC3 fault-A (kill-before-rename: target unchanged) and AC3 fault-B (kill-after-rename, parent-fsync skipped: target observable with new contents) tests in atomicWriteJson.test.ts. Q3 nit captured in recovery-script-patches.md as a clarifying note that the gate is flavor-based not schemaVersion-based. ADDITIONAL BUG FIXED: stopSession and heartbeat pruning now call codexMapping.onSessionEnd(session.happySessionId) before pidToTrackedSession.delete(pid). Q6/Q4/Q5 needed no code change (already correct). Final state: 54/54 tests pass, build clean, all codex round-2 actionable findings addressed.
